hook.en: A meranti tree can take 60 years to grow tall enough to harvest — and only minutes to cut down. Forest management decides whether there will be forests for our grandchildren.
hook.bm: Sebatang pokok meranti boleh mengambil masa 60 tahun untuk cukup tinggi bagi dituai — tetapi hanya beberapa minit untuk ditebang. Pengurusan hutan menentukan sama ada cucu-cicit kita masih mempunyai hutan.

bigIdeas.en: Forests provide timber (meranti, keruing, cengal) and non-timber products (rattan, bamboo, resin, herbs such as tongkat ali).
bigIdeas.bm: Hutan membekalkan kayu balak (meranti, keruing, cengal) dan hasil bukan kayu (rotan, buluh, damar, herba seperti tongkat ali).

bigIdeas.en: Managing forests keeps a lasting supply of resources and protects water, soil and biodiversity.
bigIdeas.bm: Pengurusan hutan memastikan bekalan sumber berterusan serta melindungi air, tanih dan kepelbagaian biologi.

bigIdeas.en: Efforts include Permanent Reserved Forests, selective logging, replanting and forest plantations, led by agencies such as the Forestry Department and FRIM.
bigIdeas.bm: Usaha termasuk Hutan Simpanan Kekal, pembalakan terpilih, penanaman semula dan ladang hutan, dipimpin oleh agensi seperti Jabatan Perhutanan dan FRIM.

question.en: Explain how selective logging keeps forests sustainable.
question.bm: Terangkan bagaimana pembalakan terpilih memastikan hutan lestari.

steps.en: Only mature trees above a minimum size are cut.
steps.bm: Hanya pokok matang melebihi saiz minimum ditebang.

steps.en: Younger trees are left to grow for the next cycle.
steps.bm: Pokok muda dibiarkan membesar untuk kitaran seterusnya.

answer.en: The forest regrows naturally, so timber can be harvested again in future cycles.
answer.bm: Hutan tumbuh semula secara semula jadi, jadi kayu boleh dituai semula pada kitaran akan datang.
